appraisal_events.evidence: elle me poussa vers lui d'un mouvement prétendu protecteur et volontairement inefficace qui me laissa en panne presque à mon point de départ. Telle est la lâcheté des gens du monde.
appraisal_events.explanation: Mme de Souvré stages an ostensibly helpful introduction to duc de Guermantes that is deliberately engineered to fail, leaving the narrator stranded and unpresented; the narrator explicitly frames this as social cowardice, and Mme d'Arpajon's parallel refusal shortly after reinforces the same exclusion.

status_effects.explanation: Despite seeking access, the narrator is left outside the desired social contact, staged directly as a rebuffed participant rather than merely as an observing consciousness.

ambiguities: The passage names the person the narrator seeks introduction to as 'duc de Guermantes', but surrounding context (maître de maison, le prince) indicates the host of this soirée is the prince de Guermantes; this may reflect an alias-resolution artifact rather than an actual appearance of the duc de Guermantes as a participant, so he was not scored.
